title: Dual-Layer Semantic-Spatial Belief Mapping for Aerial Object Goal Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08164v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aerial Object Goal Navigation (ObjectNav) requires an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) to locate a described target in an unknown outdoor environment using onboard visual observations. Vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret open-ended target descriptions and visual observations, but their frame-level outputs are often noisy, sparse, and spatially transient. We propose AeroBelief, a dual-layer semantic-spatial belief mapping framework that transforms transient VLM observations into persistent spatial guidance. It separates broad contextual plausibility from target-specific evidence: an intuition layer accumulates scene-level semantic cues for exploration, while an evidence layer preserves qualified target-specific observations for approach and confirmation. translated_title: 面向空中目标导航的双层语义-空间信念地图
translated_abstract: 空中目标导航要求无人机利用机载视觉观测在未知的户外环境中定位被描述的目标。视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够解读开放式的目标描述和视觉观测，但其帧级输出往往嘈杂、稀疏且在空间上具有瞬态性。我们提出AeroBelief，一个双层的语义-空间信念地图框架，能够将瞬态的VLM观测转化为持久的空间引导。该框架将广泛的上下文合理性与目标特定证据分离：直觉层累积场景级语义线索以支持探索，而证据层则保留符合资格的目标特定观测以支持接近与确认。通过证据门控融合，两个层被结合为空间信念热点。我们进一步引入带有保守证据资格认定的对象条件视觉推理，以提升……
tldr: 提出AeroBelief双层语义-空间信念地图框架，通过直觉层与证据层的证据门控融合，将瞬态的VLM观测转化为持久的空间信念热点，从而提升无人机在未知户外环境中的目标导航能力。
en_tdlr: AeroBelief is a dual-layer semantic-spatial belief mapping framework with evidence-gated fusion that transforms transient VLM observations into persistent spatial belief hotspots, improving UAV object goal navigation in unknown outdoor environments.
